note: New Caledonia: residence as a non-citizen is France's; a foreigner applies at a French embassy or consulate before entering, under the rules on immigrants the French State's services in New Caledonia apply, and the State's services pass the work authorisation file to the Government of New Caledonia, whose labour directorate decides it (for the contract's or the stay's length). Read in the Direction du travail et de l'emploi's guide to foreign labour (2018, dtenc.gouv.nc) on 2026-10-30; the permits follow the ordinance applying to New Caledonia, which the form doesn't separate.

sources.title: Direction du travail et de l’emploi de la Nouvelle-Calédonie, La main-d’œuvre étrangère (2018)
